title: Kingpin
wikitext:
Swedish QuakeWorld player famous for his addiction to [[Aerowalk]]. Started playing in [[1996|'96]], although taking a break from [[2001|'01]]-[[2005|'05]]. Known for taking ring at DM3 (not pent), hence the nickname "ringpin".
